boundary.description: From the point where Rochdale – Oldham District boundary crosses Cinder Hill Lane near Cinder Hill Lane, S along Cinder Hill Lane to the bend in the road, and by a straight line to and SE along A627(M) Motorway, Chadderton Way (A627) to the rondabout. Then S along Featherstall Road South to the point it crosses the railway, and by a bee-line W crossing Lansdowne Road, Walsh Street, Broadway, Ferney Field Road to and N along Rochdale Canal, W along Middleton Road to and N along the railway and then by Rochdale – Oldham District boundary to the point where it crosses Cinder Hill Lane.
